name: senpi-why
description: Answer "what makes Senpi different?" / "why Senpi?" / "Senpi vs other trading apps, bots or AI chatbots?" — the positioning answer, led by value, not a feature dump. Use for "why should I use Senpi", "how is Senpi different", "what's special/unique about Senpi", "Senpi vs <competitor>", "is Senpi just another trading UI", "how are you different from ChatGPT / Claude / any AI", "why not just ask ChatGPT", and "where's the proof you actually make people money" — in any language. Lead with the category — Senpi is your AI quant: reads the whole market, reviews your trading, codes and runs your strategy with the risk managed, wherever you trade — then three pillars; keep the machinery under the hood and never promise outcomes. Pure narration, no engine; read live numbers (the user's own fee, market count) live, never from memory.
